-- Add missing columns to recurringPlans (currently has: id, clientId, name, contentType, frequency, quantity, isActive, nextRunAt, lastRunAt, createdAt, updatedAt)
-- Queries expect: planName, postsPerCycle, topicTemplate, customPrompt, aiModel, enableWebResearch, enableImageGeneration, lastRunDate, nextRunDate, createdBy

ALTER TABLE recurringPlans
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS planName VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS postsPerCycle INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS topicTemplate TEXT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS customPrompt TEXT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS aiModel VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT 'gemini-2.5-flash',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS enableWebResearch INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS enableImageGeneration INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS lastRunDate TIMESTAMP NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS nextRunDate TIMESTAMP NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS createdBy INT NULL;

-- Backfill planName from existing name column for any existing rows
UPDATE recurringPlans SET planName = name WHERE planName IS NULL AND name IS NOT NULL;
